entry.title: How to find and hire Scooby-Doo in Fortnite Chapter 6, season 4
entry.summary:
Scooby-Doo might not have been the bravest of companions on the screen, but he can be your 'best mate' on the island in Fortnite.
Added as part of the Fortnitemares event, you can find and recruit the Great Dane to fight by your side. He even wears a Halloween-themed costume to match the vibes, and he can be invaluable as well. This guide will help you recruit Scooby without having to bribe him at all with Scooby Snacks.
Table of contents Scooby-Doo location in Fortnite How to recruit Scooby Doo in Fortnite
Scooby-Doo location in Fortnite
Scooby is located in the Viney Shafts region, and in the northern part, to be precise. You can also reach the location from Bugswatter Beach. Alternatively, just drop in the location marked by Shaggy on the map, as Scooby will be in the same place.
Screenshot by Destructoid
When you reach the location, you'll find a supermarket. Head inside, and Scooby and Shaggy will be waiting for you. You can chat with Shaggy to solve his quest, which rewards you with 10,000 seasonal XP. Alternatively, you can just interact with Scooby to hire him as your companion. To do so, you'll need to have a fair amount of Gold with you.
How to recruit Scooby Doo in Fortnite
You can recruit Scooby-Doo by spending 600 Gold, which is the usual amount for hiring NPCs. You can also choose to heal yourself from him if you're not at full health. Scooby can do a fair amount of damage when fighting by your side, which is excellent if you find yourself alone on the map.
Do note that his location can be spawned by enemies, since there's also a stalkbox that spawns close to it. Hence, you can expect a fair number of enemies to be at the location, and it's better to suit up accordingly.

The first set of Fortnitemares quests is now live in Fortnite, and one such task requires you to hit a specific number of players with Last Call.
If you're a fan of horror movies and haven't been living under a rock, you'll know precisely what this quest requires you to do. If not, this guide will help you to finish the task as swiftly as possible.
Table of contents How to hit players with Last Call in Fortnite How to become Ghostface in Fortnite
How to hit players with Last Call in Fortnite
There are three new POIs on the map as part of the Fortnitemares event. One of them converts you into Ghostface and empowers you with the Last Call. Ghostface's signature slasher knife has made its way over to the island, and it can be a lethal addition to your arsenal.
Once you have obtained the Last Call in your hand, slash players at least seven times to complete the quest. It's not necessary to kill an enemy with your hit, and you can also strike the same enemy multiple times as part of your quest progression.

You can change into Ghostface by entering a telephone booth, aka Stalkbox, on the map. You'll come out as Ghostface, having the Last Call weapon in your right hand. You can press the left mouse button and use the knife to slash enemies. Pressing the secondary fire will activate the phone and mark nearby enemies.

While you'll change into your character after an interval, the Ghostface state offers huge boosts to your in-game offensive abilities and can be crucial to outlast your opponents.

entry.title: Intel's Open-Source Strategy Is Changing At Odds With The Ethos Of Open-Source
entry.summary: For the past 21+ years of running Phoronix and even longer than that being a Linux user, I have loved and consistently promoted Intel's open-source efforts and leading Linux support. Even through Intel's difficult periods of delayed and stagnate hardware launches, what had remained consistent at the company and rather legendary had been their open-source contributions. From the Linux kernel to compiler toolchains and hundreds -- if not thousands -- of different open-source projects over the past two decades have been advanced thanks to Intel's open-source leadership. entry.title: When are Ghostface, Scooby Doo, Repo, and Huggy Wuggy coming to Fortnite

Ghostface, Scooby Doo, Repo, and Huggy Wuggy are all about to make their way onto the island in Fortnite as part of the Fortnitemare celebrations.
If you have all jumped in the update, you'll notice there are plenty of Halloween-themed items in the store. An official trailer has already revealed some of the items we will be getting as part of the Fortnitemares event.

When will the Fortnitemares cosmetics go live in Fortnite

As of writing on Oct. 9, the Fortnitemares update is live, but the cosmetics are yet to appear. They should be going live in approximately three/four hours from the time this article goes live. This is based on how Epic typically launches seasonal cosmetics when they're not released with the start of an event.
As of writing, only Doja Cat's bundle is live in the game. You can pick the full bundle up at a discounted rate, or go for the individual pieces. Other characters like Scooby Doo and Huggy Wuggy should also be made available as part of their own bundles. We will update this guide once you can buy them in Fortnite.
Incidentally, Ghostface's cosmetic might be unavailable in the store, but you can turn into him. You'll need to find a booth on the map and go inside. You'll come out as Ghostface while unlocking his unique ability, which appears to be quite powerful.

entry.title: LSN-0115-1: Kernel Live Patch Security Notice
entry.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: fs/ntfs3: Fixed overflow check in mi_enum_attr())(CVE-2024-27407).
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: netfilter: nf_reject_ipv6: fix nf_reject_ip6_tcphdr_put() syzbot reported that nf_reject_ip6_tcphdr_put() was possibly sending garbage on the four reserved tcp bits (th->res1) Use skb_put_zero() to clear the whole TCP header, as done in nf_reject_ip_tcphdr_put() BUG: KMSAN: uninit-value in nf_reject_ip6_tcphdr_put+0x688/0x6c0 net/ipv6/netfilter/nf_reject_ipv6.c:255 nf_reject_ip6_tcphdr_put+0x688/0x6c0 net/ipv6/netfilter/nf_reject_ipv6.c:255 nf_send_reset6+0xd84/0x15b0 net/ipv6/netfilter/nf_reject_ipv6.c:344 nft_reject_inet_eval+0x3c1/0x880 net/netfilter/nft_reject_inet.c:48 expr_call_ops_eval net/netfilter/nf_tables_core.c:240 .
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: smb: client: fix UAF in async decryption Doing an async decryption (large read) crashes with a slab-use-after-free way down in the crypto API.
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: ovl: fix UAF in ovl_dentry_update_reval by moving dput() in ovl_link_up The issue was caused by dput(upper) being called before ovl_dentry_update_reval(), while upper->d_flags was still accessed in ovl_dentry_remote().
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: RDMA/erdma: Prevent use-after-free in erdma_accept_newconn() After the erdma_cep_put(new_cep) being called, new_cep will be freed, and the following dereference will cause a UAF problem.

entry.title: PowerWash Simulator 2 will release October 23, and here's a trailer to mock you for enjoying cleaning games

The world is insufficiently clean and sparkly, so here comes Futurlab with Powerwash Simulator 2. The floor-mopping bonanza will release on 23rd October, a few short weeks from now. The release date announcement accompanies one of those satirical "corporate training" videos, commonly used by videogame creators to sneer indirectly at the sad unfortunates trapped in their Skinner boxes.

Fine then, Futurlab. I was looking forward to your glorified adult colouring book. I was modestly anticipating the opportunity to absent myself from my personal squalor and while away some hours in your pseudo-therapeutic tribute to Mr Muscles. He and his partner Dr Emma Fisher-Owen run Beyond the Bark, an inclusive theatrical fabrication company based in Limerick, Ireland ("éalú" is an Irish word for "escape").
Backstage know-how aside, Éalú draws upon Ivan Fisher-Owen's misgivings about the brain-souring effects of being terminally online, with some interesting metaphors for everyday hellsite routines I will try my best not to baldly unpack. entry.title: Men Who Uploaded Movies to Extract Cash From Pirates Have Been Acquitted
entry.summary: Six men have been acquitted for their part in a highly organized 'copyright-trolling' operation. After two movie companies were offered 20% of the spoils from the scheme, their movies were downloaded from BitTorrent and then seeded to downloaders who were subsequently sued. The acquittals overturn guilty verdicts handed down by a lower court. From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.

entry.title: BitTorrent’s DHT and the Leading ISP Networks Helping to Keep it Alive
entry.summary: Aside from the genius baked into the protocol itself, BitTorrent's success as a global network can be attributed to its Distributed Hash Table, commonly known by the initials DHT. Its existence goes unnoticed by millions of BitTorrent users, yet its absence would be felt all around the world. The DHT network is global and difficult to monitor comprehensively, but data shows that by IP address volume, customers of a relatively small number of ISPs dominate the DHT landscape.
